I found no toddler underwater basket weaving class in Halton Hills. I searched for the class by that name, and for basket weaving workshops in Halton Hills this fall. Every real hit was a joke or satire page, an adult or teen course, or a workshop in another city. The Halton Hills results were only swim lessons, and none was a basket weaving class.

The closest real thing is the Town of Halton Hills' own swim lessons. Its Parent and Tot level is for ages 4 months to 3 years, as of its summer 2026 page. Its fall schedule page lists Acton as Saturday, October 3 to Thursday, December 3, 2026. It lists Parent & Tot to Swimmer 3 at $86.22 for 9 lessons of 30 minutes. That page also says non-residents can register starting Tuesday, September 8. I did not read a Parent and Tot day or time for either pool, and Gellert's fall schedule was cut off in what I read.

I left it out of `picks` because it is swimming, not basket weaving. Adding it would pass off a different activity as the one the parent asked about.
